name: Simmered in salsa verde
intro: A pot of salsa verde and something simmered in it until the sauce thickens. Chicken thighs on Sunday, eggs on Wednesday.
keep: A wide pan with a lid

variations.context: The default. Simmered 25 minutes, shredded in the sauce.
Chile strips stirred in for the last five minutes.
No meat. Eggs cracked into the simmering sauce, covered until set.

finish: Bring the salsa verde to a simmer in a wide pan. For chicken, add the salted thighs, cover, and simmer gently for about 25 minutes until they shred easily — then shred them right in the sauce. For eggs, make four hollows in the simmering sauce, crack an egg into each, cover, and cook four or five minutes until the whites set.
